data.description: Acid Hardware brand mark for 声间 (Shengjian): seven-bar audio waveform inside four thin technical corner brackets, acid chartreuse on pure black, no text. Visual language matches the confirmed ui-acid-v1 direction (docs/ui/ui-direction.md, SPEC-014 #96).
data.variant_note: Second flat-color variant (a2) selected over the first for the absence of a dark halo; a CJK-character variant was generated but not adopted (glow, non-square delivery).

reuse: Derived from untracked working file output/imagegen/logo-a2-panel-emblem.png: alpha flattened onto #050505, downscaled to 512x512, saved as WebP q90. No other retouching. Candidate for app icon / favicon wiring during SPEC-014 implementation.
